newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo Nikkei closes with gains of over two percent.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo Nikkei closes with gains of over two percent.

text.p: The Tokyo stock market's benchmark Nikkei 225 average galloped higher in late afternoon trade on Tuesday to close 2.25 percent or 467.95 points higher at 21,310.59.
Brokers said the Tokyo market was spurred on by stock prices in New York, where the Dow Industrials leaped overnight to a record close for the second straight session.

"The strong U.S. markets -- both the Dow and the Nikkei futures on the Chicago Mercantile Exchange -- influenced the Tokyo markets strongly today," said Haruo Nakaharu, strategist at Toyo Securities. "The Nikkei average had some catching up to do since Monday was a holiday in Japan."
Tokyo financial markets were closed on Monday for a national holiday.
Brokers added that market sentiment had brightened considerably after the settlement of Nikkei 225 futures and options, or "special quotations" (SQ), last Friday.
